question.text: Category I and II AIFs can invest a maximum of what percentage of investable funds in a single investee company?

explanation.text: The Logic: NISM-Series-X-A (p.236) states that Category I and Category II AIFs shall invest not more than 25% of their investable funds in an investee company. Category III AIFs are restricted to a tighter 10% per investee company on the same page. The Trap: The 10% figure is the Category III limit, not the Category I/II limit; confusing the two is a common error. Note: Market-practice claims about typical 10-20 company portfolios are not in the checked page and should be cited from a separate source before being asserted.
